//go:build postingedgebench && darwin

package postingedge

// The twin of bench_diag_hooks_test.go for m2 as it is, which has neither the
// clocks of the callers nor the counters of the store: with it the harness of
// the diagnostic of the inserts builds over m2 untouched, for the control of
// what the clocks cost.

// diagBranch tells that this is not the diagnostic branch.
const diagBranch = false

func diagHooks(cfg *PersistentConfig, clocksOn, work bool) (func() map[string]int64, func()) {
	return nil, func() {}
}

func diagStore() map[string]int64 { return map[string]int64{} }
